remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00)

add_definitions(-D__WINESRC__ -D__ROS_LONG64__)
include_directories(BEFORE ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/wine)
spec2def(wbemprox.dll wbemprox.spec)

BISON_TARGET(wql wql.y ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wql.tab.c)

# wbemprox.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wbemprox-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(wbemprox_shims OBJECT builtin.c class.c main.c process.c qualifier.c query.c reg.c security.c service.c services.c sysrestore.c table.c wbemlocator.c guid.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wql.tab.c)
target_link_libraries(wbemprox_shims PRIVATE uuid wine oldnames libiphlpapi liboleaut32 libole32 libadvapi32 libuser32 libgdi32 libversion libwinspool libws2_32 librpcrt4 libsetupapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_dependencies(wbemprox_shims d3d_idl_headers)
add_cargo_module(wbemprox wbemprox-cargo wbemprox.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/wbem
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wbemprox_shims psdk uuid_sources)
